structure.unit: Titling and Registration of Motor Vehicles

law.catch_line: Vehicles owned by maritime cargo terminal operators
law.text: No person shall be required to obtain the registration certificate, certificate of title, license plates, or decals for or to pay a registration fee for any motor vehicle owned or leased by a maritime cargo terminal owner or operator and used to transport a seagoing container and operated along a highway on a route of no more than one mile approved by the Department.
